data.one_liner: Run TensorFlow Lite models in the browser using WebAssembly.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to load TensorFlow Lite models via TFLite JS/WASM and run inference in a web environment. Models can be loaded from URLs or memory and predictions are returned as tensors.
use_when: You need on‑device ML inference in a Flutter web app
You want to avoid native plugins and keep everything in the browser
avoid_when: You target mobile or desktop where native tflite_flutter offers better performance
You require GPU‑accelerated inference not available in WASM
strengths: Runs purely in the browser, no native code
Supports loading scripts from a CDN or custom hosting
WASM backend gives reasonable performance for many models
weaknesses: Performance may be lower than native implementations
data.setup_notes: Call TFLiteWeb.initializeUsingCDN() (or initialize() for custom scripts) before loading models; add the 'web' dependency in pubspec.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Native Flutter plugin for mobile/desktop with better performance and broader platform support
